messages:
maria_sales: Hey team — Moneta (enterprise finance) asked if we can guarantee a small block of dedicated headroom for their live demo Thurs 10am PT. They want low tail latency for ~300 concurrent requests for a 45-minute window. Can we do a temporary reserved uplift on their Dedicated pool?

alex_eng: Possible. Do we know region + model? also need to confirm whether they want dedicated GPUs or just burst credits.

maria_sales: Region = us-west-2, model = rdl-medium-v1 (quantized). They explicitly asked for no fallback to hosted variants during the demo — regulatory. So dedicated pool preferred.

deven_se: For 300 concurrent requests with rdl-medium-v1, rough estimate: 6 p4d-equivalent GPUs to keep p50 < 200ms. For a 1hr window we can offer a temporary "guaranteed headroom" reservation. Pricing: add a short-term reserved uplift (~0.5x of monthly rate prorated) + burst credits for any overage. I'll post numbers in a sec.

alex_eng: Operational checklist: 
- create a temporary pool label `moneta-demo-1732504321`
- set autoscale min_instances=N (N=6) and max_instances=10
- set burst_policy to allow bursting to partner pool if >=90% usage
- ensure model pinned to rdl-medium-v1 (no fallback)

alex_eng: Command (infra-tool):
```
infractl pools create --name moneta-demo-1732504321 --region us-west-2 --model rdl-medium-v1 --min-instances 6 --max-instances 10 --duration 90m --tags demo,moneta
```

maria_sales: Perfect. Does security need to sign off for the no-fallback rule? Moneta's compliance team is strict about model determinism.

sre_oncall: Heads up: if we pin the model and set min_instances high, we need a graceful drain window of 10m before teardown. Also ensure alerts for >85% GPU mem and request rate spikes. I'll add SLO overrides for the window.

deven_se: Pricing snapshot: temporary reservation for 90m -> prorated commitment = ~0.75 * hourly-dedicated-rate * 6 GPUs (that's a conservative add-on). Burst credits as needed billed at standard overage. I'll send exact quote to @lina_prod to approve.

lina_prod: Please attach the quote + approver list. I can greenlight up to $5k without exec sign-off. Anything above that needs sales lead + finance ok.

maria_sales: Noted. I'll wait for the quote. Also, can we get a short-term API key for Moneta's test users for the demo (scoped to the pool)? They want to bypass global quotas.

alex_eng: We can mint scoped API keys tied to the pool: `api_keys.create --policy pool:moneta-demo-1732504321 --scopes generate,stream --expires in 3h`. Ops_bot will create a ticket for key issuance & pool provisioning.

ops_bot: Ticket created: INF-4521 — "moneta demo: temporary dedicated pool + scoped api keys". Assignees: @alex_eng, @deven_se. ETA: 4h.

maria_sales: Thanks. One last ask — can we disable cross-region fallback? Moneta requires all compute in us-west-2.

alex_eng: Yep, set routing policy `region:strict`. Will include in the infractl command.

sre_oncall: Schedule: provisioning starts now, validation 30m before demo, drain 10m after. I'll stay oncall during the demo.

deven_se: Quote sent to @lina_prod via email (summary + line items).

maria_sales: Great — moving to exec approval. Will update thread when Moneta signs. :thumbsup:
